title: Even hypercontractivity for a PMF
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\mu$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $r$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The property holds when, for every $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the $L^{2r}$ norm under $\mu$ of the function $x\mapsto a+\rho bX(x)$ is at most the $L^2$ norm under $\mu$ of $x\mapsto a+bX(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
